item.title: Show HN: A Project Oberon System version running on RISC-V instead of RISC-5
item.description:
📝 There is also a free 2013 revision of the Project Oberon book available. Migrating the Project Oberon System from RISC-5 to RISC-V is a pragmatic way to bring the system to widely available contemporary hardware while preserving the principles that make Oberon valuable. Future iterations will migrate this (and also System 3) to the mentioned Olimex board.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/rochus-keller/OberonSystem/tree/op2-rv32

item.title: John C. Lilly on solid state intelligence and the elimination of man (1978)
item.description:
📝 These machines were so constructed that they needed special atmospheres in which to operate. Controls Below Human Awareness Over the decades these machines were connected more and more closely through satellites, through radio waves, through land-line cables. Man’s control of what happened in these machines became more and more difficult to maintain.
🔗 Read more: https://kibotronics.net/unlisted/lilly-machines/
